title: Dragging stuff from popup should produce visual feedback
line: Dragging an entry out of the clipboard popup now shows the entry's text, image or file previews under the cursor.
explanation: The text, image and URL history delegates started their drag straight from the DragHandler (Drag.active bound to dragHandler.active) and never set Drag.imageSource, so the only feedback while dragging was the cursor's copy badge. Only the QR code page grabbed an image for its drag. Now ClipboardItemDelegate's DragHandler grabs the entry's content item with grabToImage, sets it as the drag image with the hot spot where the entry was pressed, and only then starts the drag, the same pattern Kickoff and the task manager use.

commits.message:
klipper: show the dragged item under the cursor

Dragging an entry out of the clipboard popup gave no visual feedback
other than the cursor, so it wasn't clear what was being dragged. Now the
entry's text, image or file previews are used as the drag image instead.

BUG: 478586

media.caption: Master: dragging a text entry onto the desktop shows only the cursor with a copy badge
With the fix: the entry's text moves with the cursor
Master: dragging a two-file URL entry shows only the cursor
With the fix: the file previews move with the cursor
Master: dragging an image entry shows only the cursor
With the fix: the image thumbnail moves with the cursor

reviews.text: Idiomatic Plasma QML fix that centralizes drag initiation in ClipboardItemDelegate's DragHandler, grabbing menuItem.mainItem with grabToImage(), computing Drag.hotSpot from centroid.pressPosition, and clearing Drag.imageSource once the drag ends. All three delegate types (text, file URL previews, and images) are cleanly covered with convincing mid-drag before/after screenshots and drop/escape/click regression verification.
